news.title: Broadcom stock plunges on weak software sales, unchanged AI chip forecast for the year
news.detail: Broadcom reported fiscal second-quarter results on Wednesday and missed estimates for revenue.

news.title: Inside India newsletter: Why Taiwan and South Korea's stock markets have surged past India within a week
news.detail: The Indian equity market is losing favour with global investors, as its domestic consumption story weakens and the country lags in AI.

news.title: Quantinuum IPO定价为每股60美元 高于推介区间
news.detail: 据一份声明称，霍尼韦尔支持的美国量子计算公司Quantinuum首次公开募股（IPO）发行2800万股股票，定价为每股60美元，高于该公司此前公布的每股53至55美元的发行价区间。

news.title: SpaceX targets $135 IPO price at valuation of $1.77 trillion
news.detail: The valuation would make Elon Musk's company the seventh-biggest in the U.S., above Tesla, which has a market cap of about $1.6 trillion.

news.title: Beware SpaceX buyers: Major IPOs are typically a rough ride in the first year
news.detail: A review of 30 major IPOs over the past 15 years shows companies tend to have a rough start, according to Truist Wealth.

news.title: Historic stock rally faces key test
news.detail: Two key tech companies reporting earnings after the bell could determine the next move higher or lower.

news.title: 消息人士：摩根大通的戴蒙将向富豪客户推介SpaceX的IPO
news.detail: 一位知情人士周三透露，摩根大通首席执行官戴蒙本周将向该行的高净值客户 推介SpaceX即将进行的首次公开募股（IPO），旨在推动散户参与这场创纪录的募股活动。

news.title: 博通股价盘后下跌 AI芯片营收预测不及预期
news.detail: 博通股价盘后下跌，该公司公布的人工智能芯片营收预测不及预期，显示其在这一快速增长行业中争取更大份额的进展慢于外界预期。

news.title: 韩国股市大幅低开，追随隔夜美股走势，因伊朗局势再度紧张
news.detail: 受美伊中东停战谈判前景不明拖累、美股隔夜大跌影响，韩国股市周四开盘大幅走低。 韩国综合股价指数（KOSPI）开盘下跌 177.67 点，跌幅 2.02%，报 8623.82 点。

news.title: 随着量子计算热潮升温 霍尼韦尔旗下Quantinuum在美国首次公开募股中筹集16.8亿美元
news.detail: 霍尼韦尔旗下公司Quantinuum周三表示，其在美国首次公开募股（IPO）中以每股60美元的价格定价，共筹集16.8亿美元，投资者纷纷涌向市场中增长迅速的新兴技术领域之一。
